Self-paced workshop progress

Your workshop achievements.

Track workshop milestones, badges, and points on this browser and device. These are self-reported learning achievements, not an evaluation of agent capability or independently verified proof.

Local versus verified: local points are private, self-reported checkpoint progress. An earned badge remains Local unsynced until it appears in the accepted public metrics snapshot as Verified synced. No local progress is sent automatically.

Private by default

The profile stores only workshop slugs and modes, checkpoint counts and completion booleans, achievement booleans and timestamps, and the calculated score.

It does not store a name, email, access token, or GitHub credential. Exported files exclude the optional public-profile highlight below.

Local data controls

Export, import, or reset only the privacy-filtered local achievement profile. Import discards unknown fields rather than trusting them.

Opt-in public verified achievements

Public verified achievements come from submitted achievement progress issues, not from this browser's local score. Opening the prefilled form is not a sync until it is submitted. Resubmitting later merges newly earned canonical badge IDs without duplicate score; the server computes the verified score. One public GitHub issue submission opts that account into a public verified profile.

Stored locally under a separate preference key and used to compare Local unsynced badges with that public row's Verified synced IDs. This does not authenticate the account, prove ownership, or change public data.
